Looks better than it is
Dec 2015 • Couples
This is a well situated, small, clean and well decorated restaurant very near to the Temple of Literature, just set back from an amazing road junction where the antics of drivers, and the death-defying feats of the motorcyclists have to be seen to be believed. The food is reasonably priced and you cannot fault the service, however, the food that I ate, 'beef fried rice' was exceptionally bland. My wife had the 'noodles with mushrooms and onions', and it looked like the noodles had been fished out of a pot-noodle container and plonked on the plate. My wife could only eat the vegetables and left the noodles to themselves. I would only recommend this place as a coffee shop/drinks stop,
